tagline.en: UK-number SIM and eSIM: separate PAYG keep-alive from Plus bundles
tagline.zh: 英国号码 SIM 与 eSIM，分清 PAYG 保号和 Plus 套餐

description.en: Vodafone UK publicly sells Pay as you go Plus with an eSIM option; you do not have to negotiate a customer-service-only deal. Checked 25 November 2026: the £10 plan includes 27GB per 30 days for the first three months, then 8GB, with the offer ending 8 December 2026. Plus uses a payment card and the My Vodafone smartphone app, with optional auto-renew. Traditional PAYG has a separate 180-day chargeable-activity rule. Neither a digital SIM nor free incoming texts alone guarantees that a number stays active.
description.zh: Vodafone 英国已在官网公开销售支持 eSIM 的 Pay as you go Plus，无需把客服议价当作唯一购买路径。2026-11-25 核查，£10 档前 3 个月每 30 天含 27GB，之后为 8GB，活动截止 2026-12-08。Plus 使用支付卡与 My Vodafone 手机 App 管理，可关闭自动续订。传统 PAYG 则另有 180 天内发生付费活动的保号规则。下载 eSIM、收到免费短信，都不能直接当作保号已完成的凭证。

details.en:
### Public eSIM purchase and activation

Checked 25 November 2026 against Vodafone's [Plus storefront](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim) and [Plus help page](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim/how-payg-plus-works). Compatible phones can select an eSIM on a publicly listed Plus plan. Vodafone emails the download instructions; physical SIMs remain available too. The earlier customer-service-only description was based on a March 2026 review and no longer describes the public sales route. The current storefront says no contract or credit check. That is not a promise of anonymous registration or exemption from account checks.

### What the £10 bundle buys

The £10 Plus plan gives 27GB per 30-day period for the first three months and 8GB afterwards, plus unlimited UK minutes and texts. The £15, £20 and £30 tiers also have three-month data promotions, shown separately below. The advertised offer ends 8 December 2026; this is the promotion deadline, not a guarantee that the extra allowance lasts indefinitely. Auto-renew charges the registered payment card every 30 days. Turn it off in My Vodafone if you want the plan to pause after the paid period. Plus needs a smartphone and the app.

### Keep-alive and roaming are separate questions

The official [traditional PAYG page](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim/payg-1) requires a chargeable activity within 180 days, with a reminder after 90 days without use or top-up. Receiving an incoming text is not the chargeable outbound activity described there. Do not assume that pausing a Plus bundle automatically switches the line onto PAYG 1, or that the two products have identical charging rules. Check the agreement attached to the actual line. Vodafone's Plus activation help says to activate the SIM in the UK before travelling abroad. An emailed eSIM QR code alone does not establish that first activation from China is supported.

### Choosing a UK number for use abroad

This is a local UK-number product, not a generic travel-data eSIM. Check the intended destination's roaming charges and the cost of a qualifying activity before relying on it for long-term number retention. The public UK bundle allowance does not by itself prove that China or EU roaming is included. We have not re-verified the old festival-trial or customer-service-only offers and do not list them as current deals. Compare the [UK keep-alive guide](/news/uk-sim-keep-alive-guide-2026/) for other retention rules; no option guarantees that a particular website will accept its number.
details.zh:
### 官网可以买到 eSIM

本页于 2026-11-25 对照 Vodafone 的 [Plus 套餐页](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim)与 [Plus 使用说明](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim/how-payg-plus-works)复核。支持 eSIM 的手机可在公开销售的 Plus 套餐中选择 eSIM，下载说明由邮件发送，也可以选实体卡。旧版“便宜 eSIM 只能找客服”的说法来自 2026 年 3 月盘点，已不适合描述当前购买路径。官网写明无需合约或信用审查，但这不代表匿名开户，也不保证账户不会被要求补充资料。

### £10 套餐包含什么

£10 的 Plus 套餐前 3 个月每个 30 天周期含 27GB，之后恢复 8GB，并有英国境内无限通话与短信。£15、£20 和 £30 档也有前三个月额外流量，具体数量列在套餐表。官网所写的 2026-12-08 是这次优惠的截止日，不能理解成额外流量永久有效。自动续订会每 30 天从登记的支付卡扣款；不打算继续用时，可在 My Vodafone 关闭续订，让当前付费周期结束后暂停套餐。Plus 需要智能手机和 App 管理。

### 保号与漫游要分开核对

官方[传统 PAYG 说明](https://www.vodafone.co.uk/sim-only/pay-as-you-go-sim/payg-1)要求 180 天内发生符合规则的付费活动，90 天无使用或充值会先提醒。只收到一条免费短信，不能当作已完成付费使用。也不要默认关闭 Plus 续订后就会自动转成 PAYG 1，或把两种产品的计费规则直接混用，应查看自己号码实际适用的协议。Plus 激活说明要求出国前先在英国激活；收到邮件里的 eSIM 二维码，不等于已证明可从中国完成首次激活。

### 适合什么用途

Vodafone UK 是带英国号码的本地通信产品，与只提供上网的旅行 eSIM 不同。长期在海外持有号码前，要先查目的地漫游价格，再算一次有效付费活动的实际成本。英国本地套餐额度不能直接理解为中国或欧盟漫游也包含在内。旧版提到的音乐节免费试用与客服专属报价，本轮没有复核为当前可购活动，不列作现行优惠。可结合站内[英国保号卡指南](/zh/news/uk-sim-keep-alive-guide-2026/)比较其他号码的规则；任何运营商号码都不保证某个网站一定接受。

plansNote.en: Tariffs verified on Vodafone's public Plus pages on 25 Nov 2026. Prices are GBP per 30 days, not calendar-month fees. The directory USD floor is approximately $13.10 for £10 using ECB reference rates dated 24 Nov 2026, not a USD billing offer. Plus renewal, traditional PAYG retention and overseas roaming have separate rules.

note.en: A motorhome forum thread reports a dealer-verified case: Vodafone UK SIMs roaming in Portugal kept a UK IP and streamed iPlayer fine, matching what multiple customers reported. Consistent with UK MNO home-routing practice; no official Vodafone doc on exit IP.
note.zh: 房车论坛帖子（经销商验证）称 Vodafone UK 卡在葡萄牙漫游保持英国 IP、iPlayer 正常，多个客户反馈一致；符合英国运营商母网回程惯例，但官方无出口 IP 文档。
